name: @pipeworx/mcp-quran

tools.name: list_surahs
tools.description: List all 114 surahs (chapters) of the Quran with their Arabic name, English name, English translation, ayah (verse) count, and revelation type (Meccan/Medinan).

tools.name: get_surah
tools.description: Get the full text of a surah (chapter) of the Quran by its number (1-114). Returns every ayah (verse) in the chosen edition. Use an English translation edition (e.g. en.asad, en.sahih) for English, or quran-uthmani for the Arabic text.

edition.description: Edition identifier. Default 'en.asad' (English translation). Other examples: 'en.sahih' (English), 'quran-uthmani' (Arabic).

tools.name: get_ayah
tools.description: Get a single ayah (verse) of the Quran by reference — either surah:ayah (e.g. "2:255" for Ayat al-Kursi) or a global ayah number (1-6236). Returns the verse text in the chosen edition (translation like en.asad / en.sahih, or Arabic via quran-uthmani).

reference.description: Verse reference: "surah:ayah" like "2:255", or a global ayah number like "262".

edition.description: Edition identifier. Default 'en.asad'. Use 'quran-uthmani' for Arabic.

tools.name: search_quran
tools.description: Search the Quran for a keyword across ayahs (verses). Returns matching verses (up to 30) with their surah (chapter) and ayah number. Defaults to the en.asad English translation; pass another edition to search a different translation or Arabic (quran-uthmani).

keyword.description: Word or phrase to search for.

surah.description: Restrict to a surah number, or 'all' for the whole Quran (default).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-quran forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the quran pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
